metadata.notes: Second offline EntityNarrativeState fixture. Used to test whether the shape generalizes to a simpler fallback/control case rather than a Builtwith-style owned-claim/entity-ambiguity case.

primary_entity_signal.label: Netlify is represented as a serverless/builder platform with consistent external coverage and limited differentiation evidence.
primary_entity_signal.supporting_payload_excerpt: Netlify presents a clear message backed by consistent external coverage. Press and encyclopedic sources reinforce its serverless positioning.
primary_entity_signal.uncertainty: This fixture is derived from a compact mock/control payload, not a full live report evidence set.

entity_aliases.notes: Unlike builtwith.kit.com, the available payload does not show meaningful entity drift or adjacent-surface ambiguity.

owned_claim_density.notes: The Netlify control case does not rely on repeated owned-claim attribution.

owned_or_self_description.notes: Owned Netlify surfaces appear in the payload evidence URLs, but the narrative does not repeatedly frame findings as owned claims.

third_party_or_external_assessment.notes: External coverage supports the payload's presence and perception statements.

technical_or_configuration.notes: No technical/configuration source bucket is visible in the compact mock payload.

uncited_or_missing_evidence_url.notes: Two findings contain narrative text but no evidence URLs.

repeated_opener_budget.notes: Rendering suppresses the repeated title opening, but the observation opening remains visible across all five dimensions.

attribution_budget.notes: Safe attribution repetition is not the dominant failure mode in this fixture.

corroboration_caveat_budget.notes: No external-corroboration caveat repetition is visible in the Netlify control diagnostics.

fallback_language_budget.notes: This is the primary measured cohesion risk in the Netlify fixture.

evidence_url_coverage.notes: Coverage is stronger than a no-evidence fallback, but not complete enough to justify identical evidence-opening language in every finding.

primary_tension.summary: The payload states a clear platform presence with still-limited differentiation versus alternatives.
primary_tension.supporting_payload_excerpt: Main tension: strong presence but still-limited differentiation versus alternatives.
primary_tension.uncertainty: No separate tensions_prose field exists in the source payload, so this remains a weak manually consolidated tension rather than a validated entity-level state.

contradiction_candidates_status.notes: No explicit stated-claim-versus-observed-signal contradiction appears in the compact Netlify control payload.

decision_space_mode.notes: The payload does not contain typical_decision text, so this fixture does not test Decision Space suppression.

compression_candidates.editorial_reason: The same fallback observation is visible across all dimensions, making the report feel assembled even though the payload is structurally valid.
compression_candidates.suggested_action: Compress the shared fallback condition into a single entity-level caveat or replace repeated observations with dimension-specific evidence statements.

compression_candidates.editorial_reason: Findings without evidence URLs should avoid language that implies consolidated corroboration.
compression_candidates.suggested_action: Either attach evidence URLs or render these findings with more cautious fallback language.

fields_not_applicable_or_empty.reason: No external corroboration caveat repetition detected.
No contradiction candidate is supported by the compact payload.
No typical_decision text exists in the fixture payload.

explicit_non_goals: Do not use this fixture for scoring.
Do not use this fixture to change prompts.
Do not use this fixture to change report rendering.
Do not treat compression candidates as automated rewrite instructions.
Do not infer brand intent, archetype, audience psychology, or market strategy from this fixture.
